candidates.title: FairBatching: Fairness-Aware Batch Formation for LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Implemented LLM inference scheduling work that jointly addresses prefill/decode fairness, adaptive batch capacity, SLO preservation, and cluster load estimation. Trace-based evaluation reports tail-latency and capacity improvements, making it a useful scheduling-lineage omission despite being older than the newest papers.

discovery_stats.axis: prefill/decode fairness / adaptive batching / SLO scheduling
discovery_stats.query_summary: Changed to scheduler/resource-allocation work after three memory-system rounds. MFS and SuperInfer were already represented in the known search state; FairBatching was not found by repository code search and provides concrete scheduler mechanisms plus realistic trace evaluation.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Move to speculative-decoding serving/runtime or agentic multi-turn scheduling, avoiding generic SLO scheduling overlap.
